publication_name: London Stock Exchange website instrument pages
access_description: Public LSEG website pages that describe listed instruments. No instrument list was downloaded.
auth_requirement: The website terms do not offer an open API key for instrument lists.
conditions: Do not run an automated collector. Section 10 forbids bots, scripts, and bulk download for any purpose. Section 9 allows only personal non-professional copies, not storage on a networked server and not incorporation into a publication. A paid market-data licence was not assessed as granted.
revision_behaviour: Website pages can change without a vintage. No list was stored.
unresolved_questions: A separate London Stock Exchange market-data contract would be required before any licensed feed. AI processing of website text is not named apart from a ban on automated use of LSEG AI tools.
evidence_note: On 23 October 2026 the LSEG website terms of use prohibited automated tools, including searches and bulk downloads, and prohibited copying website information to third parties for commercial gain. Personal non-professional storage must not be on a server connected to a network. No listing file was downloaded.
